system.description:
The vampire can view the ghosts of the dead inhabiting an area upon which she focuses her attention, and determine their general attitude. Relatives of the recently deceased often seek out a local Sielanic shaman to ask whether the departed's soul seems content or needs propitiating.

System: The vampire expends a blood point and concentrates on a specific area, then rolls Willpower. A single success detects the presence of any wraiths or Spectres nearby; more successes reveal details of the ghost's attitude.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book Two: Usurpers
